messages:
Ava (PM): Quick design review — new 'Running Start' first-run flow mock uploaded. Two variants: 'panel' (left rail persistent checklist) vs 'mini-portal' (center modal card with sample projects). Thoughts? Link: https://figma.example/abc :eyes:

Diego (Design): Panel is better for power users. Mini-portal feels friendlier for new devs. I'm worried about banner clutter if we also show quickstart banner.

Riley (DevEx): @Diego +1 to mini-portal on small screens. We should keep CTA hierarchy: primary = 'Create sample project', secondary = 'Import repo'.

Sam (Eng): Implementation caveat: panel requires live sidebar state across routes; will add complexity for mobile. Mini-portal can be a dismissible overlay — easier.

Olivia (Accessibility): Accessibility nits: focus trap for modal, keyboard nav between sample cards, and color contrast for CTA (#4A90E2 on white is ok but hover states drop too low). Also need aria-live for setup progress toast.

Diego (Design): Good call. Updated mock: added focus ring, explicit 'Skip' button visible, and bigger hit targets. Also changed CTA copy to 'Start with sample' instead of 'Get started' — more specific.

Ava (PM): Metrics: track 'completed setup' (clicked sample project + first run build), 'time to first API call', and dropoff after 2 minutes. Proposal: run A/B test panel vs mini-portal for 2 weeks.

Riley (DevEx): We can gate A/B by new accounts only. Also add an opt-in telemetry flag so enterprise customers can disable. Snippet for quick flag: ```json
{"onboarding_experiment":"mini_portal_v1","user_bucket":42}
```

Sam (Eng): Dev question: sample projects list size? Preload 3 vs 6. 3 reduces cognitive load; 6 shows variety. Performance: lazy-load thumbnails.

Olivia (Accessibility): Recommend 3 visible + 'more samples' link. Also ensure alt text for thumbnails and avoid auto-play gifs.

Ava (PM): Decision: start with mini-portal + 3 samples + CTA 'Start with sample' + A11y fixes. Follow-ups: @Diego update mocks, @Sam add dismiss persistence (localStorage + server flag), @Riley add experiment flag + telemetry events. I'll write the ticket.

onboard-bot: Design file 'Running Start - Mini Portal' uploaded by Diego. https://figma.example/abc - 1728501270

Diego (Design): :thumbsup: will update now. I'll post new link before EOD.

Riley (DevEx): I'll draft the event schema (onboarding.started, onboarding.completed, onboarding.skipped) and share in #devex. Can we include 'initial_latency' (time to first token) as a dimension?

Sam (Eng): Yep, we can emit that from the runtime wrapper.

Olivia (Accessibility): One last nits: ensure skip is reachable from keyboard and announced by screenreaders. Also test with zoom 200%.

Ava (PM): Thanks all. Quick action items in thread. :rocket:
